name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo Oliveira's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the technical aspects of racing. Growing up near the Estoril circuit, he was captivated by the meticulous preparation and attention to detail required to maintain racing vehicles. This interest led him to pursue a degree in engineering, specializing in security systems. After graduation, he honed his skills in various security roles before transitioning to motorsport, aiming to apply his expertise to protect teams and assets.

Ricardo is known for his proactive approach to security. He emphasizes preventative measures, implementing rigorous protocols and conducting regular risk assessments to identify potential vulnerabilities. His keen eye for detail and dedication to security make him a valuable asset to any racing team. He is a perfectionist, always striving to improve security measures and stay ahead of emerging threats, ensuring the safety and integrity of the team's operations.

His experience and commitment to staying abreast of the latest security technologies set him apart. Ricardo consistently seeks out new training opportunities and certifications to enhance his knowledge and skills, ensuring that the team benefits from the most up-to-date security practices.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a serious demeanor etched on his face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down security observations.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses even when they're perfectly in place.
Insists on checking every lock and seal multiple times before leaving for the day.
